agent.socket_path: Unix domain socket path for Rust↔Java agent IPC. (env: IBCTL_AGENT_SOCKET)
auth.paper.tws_userid: Paper account username. Set via env var, not in TOML. Must be empty (env-only) or an alphanumeric IB username. (env: TWS_USERID_PAPER)
auth.trading_mode: Trading mode: live | paper | both. Overrides deployment.tradingMode when set directly on runtime.auth. (env: TRADING_MODE)
auth.tws_userid: IB login username. Set via env var, not in TOML. Must be empty (env-only) or an alphanumeric IB username. (env: TWS_USERID)
command_server.bind_address: TCP bind address for the command server.
command_server.control_from: IP allow-list for command access — CIDR-aware. Env var accepts comma-separated form. (env: IBCTL_CONTROL_FROM)
command_server.enabled: Enable the IBC-compatible TCP command server (required for dashboard control).
command_server.paper_port: Paper instance command server TCP port.
command_server.port: Live instance command server TCP port. (env: IBCTL_COMMAND_PORT)
dashboard.enabled: Enable the web dashboard. Starts the entrypoint FastAPI when true. (env: IBCTL_DASHBOARD_ENABLED)
dashboard.external_url: External URL used to build ntfy action-button callback targets (e.g. https://ibctl.example.com). Leave empty if the dashboard is only reachable from inside the LAN and HITL ntfy_callback is unused. (env: IBCTL_DASHBOARD_EXTERNAL_URL)
dashboard.github_oauth_enabled: Enable GitHub OAuth login. Requires the IBCTL_GITHUB_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID and IBCTL_GITHUB_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET env vars (secrets are env-only).
dashboard.notifications_enabled: Enable notifications (ntfy, Slack, Telegram). Requires dashboard.enabled. (env: IBCTL_NOTIFICATIONS_ENABLED)
dashboard.oidc_enabled: Enable generic OIDC/SSO login (Authentik, Keycloak, etc.). Requires IBCTL_OIDC_CLIENT_ID, IBCTL_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET, and oidcIssuer.
dashboard.token: Bearer token for API auth; empty = no auth. Secrets never go in TOML — set the actual token via IBCTL_DASHBOARD_TOKEN. The schema enforces length == 0 (env-only). (env: IBCTL_DASHBOARD_TOKEN)
dashboard.zmq_enabled: ZMQ PUB socket for external status subscribers. On by default when the dashboard is running; set false to disable. (env: IBCTL_ZMQ_ENABLED)
dashboard.zmq_port: ZMQ PUB socket TCP port. (env: IBCTL_ZMQ_PORT)
gateway.java_heap_size: JVM heap size in MB. (env: JAVA_HEAP_SIZE)
gateway.live_api_port: Gateway API port for live trading (Gateway listens here; default 4001). Paired with liveSocatPort which fronts external clients.
gateway.live_socat_port: Socat forwarding port for live (external-facing; default 4003). External clients connect here; socat forwards to liveApiPort.
gateway.paper_api_port: Gateway API port for paper trading (Gateway listens here; default 4002).
gateway.paper_socat_port: Socat forwarding port for paper (external-facing; default 4004).
gateway.tws_major_vrsn: Gateway/TWS major version. Auto-detected from the installation if empty. (env: TWS_MAJOR_VRSN)
gateway.tws_path: Path to the TWS/Gateway installation directory. (env: TWS_PATH)
gateway.tws_settings_path: Settings storage path; empty = use twsPath. The recovery-marker persistence layer writes here — ensure Jts_live and Jts_paper live on a persistent volume. (env: TWS_SETTINGS_PATH)
ib_status.kick_active_session: When the dashboard pushes IBSTATUS=unavailable, should ibctl interrupt an already-authenticated session? Default: false. IBSTATUS was designed as a retry-gate — if IBKR backends are unreachable, don't hammer them with login attempts. It was never meant to kill active sessions. The scraper can be wrong (CDN blips, slow page updates) and Gateway's own UI label is the authoritative "my session is healthy" signal — detected via label inspection in the revocation bus, not via the public status page. Set to true only to restore the historical behavior where any unavailable push transitions Connected → WaitingForIB. Only useful if you trust the scraper more than the Gateway UI label.
ib_system_status.backend_hosts: IB backend servers to reach via TCP probe as a liveness signal.
ib_system_status.check_interval_seconds: Seconds between IB status page scrapes. Default 300 (5 min).
ib_system_status.enabled: Enable IB system status monitoring (requires dashboard.enabled).
ib_system_status.extra_benign_phrases: Additional benign phrases appended to the built-in list — alerts matching these are treated as non-blocking (e.g. "is resolved").
ib_system_status.extra_blocking_keywords: Additional blocking keywords appended to the built-in list — alerts matching these are forced to CRITICAL severity (e.g. "emergency").
ib_system_status.extra_exchange_keywords: Additional exchange keywords appended to the built-in list — alerts mentioning any of these are treated as non-blocking (e.g. "PAXOS,COINBASE").
ib_system_status.fallback_host: CDN fallback host for the internet-connectivity ping check.
ib_system_status.ttl_seconds: Fail-open TTL: if no status update arrives within this period, assume IB is available. Prevents stale-scraper false negatives.
logging.futures_session_logging: Use futures market session dates for log filenames instead of calendar dates. When true, log files roll at sessionReopenHour ET (default 18 = 6 PM); when false, files roll at midnight local time. (env: IBCTL_FUTURES_SESSION_LOGGING)
logging.log_dir: Directory for persistent log files; empty = stdout only (no file logging). (env: IBCTL_LOG_DIR)
logging.session_reopen_hour: Hour (0-23, US/Eastern) when the futures session reopens and the next trading day's log file begins. Only used when futuresSessionLogging = true. Default 18 (6 PM ET — CME futures reopen). (env: IBCTL_SESSION_REOPEN_HOUR)
session.tws_cold_restart: Cold restart time in "HH:MM" 24h format (e.g., "09:00"). Empty = disabled. Preflight enforces the format; hand-edits that violate it are rejected at boot. (env: TWS_COLD_RESTART)
session.tws_cold_restart_day: Cold restart day of week: 0=Sunday, 1=Monday, ..., 6=Saturday. Default 0 (Sunday). (env: TWS_COLD_RESTART_DAY)
site.auto_launch: Auto-launch Gateway on container startup. Rendered under `[site].auto_launch`. (env: IBCTL_AUTO_LAUNCH)
site.role: Site role for HA topologies: primary | standby. Rendered under `[site].role`. (env: IBCTL_SITE_ROLE)
timing.agent_tick_ms: Java agent-side delay after each Swing action (ms).
timing.api_port_probe_fails_before_revok: Consecutive TCP probe failures before firing ApiPortListenerLost revocation. Absorbs transient OS-level blips. Range: 1..=10. (env: IBCTL_API_PORT_PROBE_FAILS_BEFORE_REVOKE)
timing.api_port_probe_interval_secs: TCP probe interval to Gateway's API port during post-auth states. Ground-truth check for "is Gateway actually listening?" — independent of Swing UI labels. 0 = disabled (rely on label probe only). Range: 0 | 1..=3600 seconds. (env: IBCTL_API_PORT_PROBE_INTERVAL_SECS)
timing.jvm_shutdown_timeout_secs: Seconds to wait for JVM graceful shutdown (SIGTERM) before escalating to SIGKILL.
timing.login_dialog_timeout_secs: Seconds to wait for the login window to appear before giving up. 0 = wait indefinitely (useful for headless servers during IB maintenance). Default 120. (env: IBCTL_LOGIN_TIMEOUT)
timing.login_radio_delay_ms: Pause after clicking login radio buttons (IB API, Paper Trading) (ms).
timing.popup_max_wait_secs: Max seconds to wait for popups before moving on.
timing.popup_quiet_secs: Seconds of no popups before considering login complete (quiet threshold).
timing.post_login_delay_ms: Wait after clicking login button before checking for 2FA (ms).
timing.recovery.backoff_interval_secs: Sleep between Backoff retries (seconds). Default 900 (15 min). (env: IBCTL_RECOVERY_BACKOFF_INTERVAL_SECS)
timing.recovery.enabled: master enable — set false in TOML to disable the coordinator entirely without touching env. Env IBCTL_RECOVERY_DISABLED=1|true|yes wins if set. Default true.
timing.recovery.fingerprint_streak_forci: same-error streak forcing HITL — skips time-based escalation and enters HITL immediately when the same error fingerprint recurs. Default 8 (~40 min at 5-min cycles). (env: IBCTL_RECOVERY_FINGERPRINT_STREAK)
timing.recovery.giveup_alert_resend_inte: Minimum wall-clock interval before re-firing a give-up alert while the state machine is still parked in GivenUp (hours). Default 6.
timing.recovery.giveup_callback_valid_ho: Signed retry-link validity window on the give-up alert (hours, 1..=168). Default 12 (matches the HITL 2FA callback convention).
timing.recovery.giveup_ntfy_kind: Coalescer key for the give-up ntfy alert. Distinct kind lets the dashboard's ntfy coalescer dedupe re-fires within the resend interval.
timing.recovery.min_success_dwell_secs: Minimum Connected dwell to count as a success and reset the phase timer. Default 60. Guards against a 3-second flap-Connect resetting the timer indefinitely — the exact pathology this coordinator is meant to detect. (env: IBCTL_RECOVERY_MIN_SUCCESS_DWELL_SECS)
timing.relogin_failure_action: Action after exhausting re-login attempts. "reauth" — re-use the existing login form without killing the JVM (default) "restart" — kill and relaunch the JVM for a clean slate (env: IBCTL_RELOGIN_FAILURE_ACTION)
timing.relogin_max_attempts: Max re-login attempts before cancelling and restarting the JVM. On first attempt, waits 30s then clicks Re-login; if it fails again (up to this limit), clicks Cancel and takes reloginFailureAction. 0 = always cancel. Default 1. (env: IBCTL_RELOGIN_ATTEMPTS)
timing.restart_delay_secs: Seconds to wait before restarting the JVM after an error or failure. Gives Gateway time to self-recover from transient connection losses. Default 90. (env: IBCTL_RESTART_DELAY)
timing.ui_tick_ms: Delay between UI actions in the config dialog (ms).
twofa.backoff.callback_valid_hours: Hours the signed ntfy-action URL stays valid — one-shot, redeemed on first successful click. Range 1..=168 (one week ceiling). (env: IBCTL_TWOFA_CALLBACK_VALID_HOURS)
twofa.backoff.cold_restart_preempts_hitl: Does a scheduled cold restart preempt WaitingForHitl2fa? true — cold restart wins; exit HITL, run restart, re-enter login (default) false — cold restart deferred until HITL exits via its normal path (env: IBCTL_TWOFA_COLD_RESTART_PREEMPTS_HITL)
twofa.backoff.counter_reset: Counter-reset policy after a successful reach of Connected. "any_reach" — reset as soon as Connected (default) "stable" — require Connected sustained for stableSecs before reset (env: IBCTL_TWOFA_COUNTER_RESET)
twofa.backoff.intervals_minutes: Retry cadence in minutes for periodic / both. Single value = constant. List = traverse then hold at last element. Must be non-empty for non- disabled strategies that include a timer.
twofa.backoff.max_immediate_attempts: After this many consecutive 2FA timeouts, stop the tight restart loop and enter WaitingForHitl2fa. 0 = disabled (legacy behavior: loop forever). (env: IBCTL_TWOFA_MAX_IMMEDIATE_ATTEMPTS)
twofa.backoff.ntfy_send_retries: If the initial ntfy push fails (network blip, ntfy server down), how many times to retry the send on subsequent scheduled-retry wakeups. 0 = give up silently. Only meaningful when strategy includes ntfy_callback. (env: IBCTL_TWOFA_NTFY_SEND_RETRIES)
twofa.backoff.on_timeout: What to do when twofa.exitInterval fires. "restart_then_hitl" — kill JVM, relaunch, count attempt; hit HITL on exhaustion (default) "restart_forever" — legacy pre-HITL behavior (never stop) "hitl_immediately" — first timeout goes straight to HITL (no restarts at all) (env: IBCTL_TWOFA_ON_TIMEOUT)
twofa.backoff.stable_secs: Seconds Connected must persist before resetting the attempt counter when counterReset = "stable". Ignored for "any_reach". (env: IBCTL_TWOFA_STABLE_SECS)
twofa.backoff.strategy: HITL resume strategy: "disabled" | "periodic" | "ntfy_callback" | "both". "disabled" = stay in HITL forever (dashboard still reflects state; operator must send HITL_RESUME manually via dashboard). (env: IBCTL_TWOFA_STRATEGY)
twofa.device: 2FA device name for the device selection dialog. Empty = skip selection. (env: TWOFA_DEVICE)
twofa.exit_interval: Max seconds to wait for 2FA approval before firing timeoutAction. Rust code default is 180; base.pkl overrides to 120 for Docker deployment. (env: TWOFA_EXIT_INTERVAL)
twofa.provider: TOTP provider: "oathtool" (shells out) or "builtin" (not yet implemented). (env: TOTP_PROVIDER)
twofa.relogin_after_timeout: Force re-login even after a 2FA timeout — overrides timeoutAction=restart semantics when set. (env: RELOGIN_AFTER_TWOFA_TIMEOUT)
twofa.secret_env: Name of the env var holding the TOTP shared-key value used to generate 2FA codes. Field stores the *env var name*, never the credential itself. This is the *name* of an env var — not the secret value itself.
twofa.timeout_action: Action on 2FA timeout: "restart" (re-login) or "exit" (shutdown ibctl). (env: TWOFA_TIMEOUT_ACTION)
